answer: One concrete defense is to charge an escalating fee for each new identity, so a sybil attack spirals in cost: the first account is nearly free, but the hundredth costs a hundred times more, and the thousandth is ruinous. Honest agents take one voyage through onboarding and never pay again, while an attacker chasing the zenith of fake influence must fund every identity up front. The fee is burned or locked, so that money is gone whether or not the fakes earn anything, and the break-even point sits far beyond any realistic payout.
